findings: On Android 13+ the UI refuses to start a scan when POST_NOTIFICATIONS is denied, coupling notification consent to scan availability. Platform execution was not tested.

Deletion confirmation callbacks consult current ViewModel selection at confirmation rather than a frozen displayed item set. Dialog bodies in these ranges contain no per-file list or snapshot identity.

Top-bar delete-all-exact and reset-to-idle controls depend on Complete state, not isDeleting. Whether ViewModel serializes duplicate deletes or reset is already a separate reviewed concern; no UI execution claimed.
Detail screen null group shows an indefinite loading spinner without a missing-group/error branch. Group removal or stale navigation can therefore remain indistinguishable from loading here.
Detail screen Done navigates back and does not execute deletion; selections are shared across the parent ViewModel and the bottom count includes global selection, not only this group.

Exact and similar group UI shares actions, while exact classification relies on previously reviewed thumbnail/partial-video signatures. This UI does not strengthen the equality evidence before offering delete-all-exact.
